annotation.summary_en: A failing law student outsmarts his elderly professor by challenging him to solve a legal logic riddle about the professor's own personal life.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: In a university classroom setting, an elderly, bearded professor wearing a sweater vest and eyeglasses is prepared to fail a male student named Martirosyan. The professor warns him that without passing this exam, he will be expelled and miss his chance to become a lawyer who solves people's problems. The student, seeing his predicament, proposes a deal: he will ask the professor three professional questions, and if the professor cannot answer, the student gets a passing grade of '5'. The professor agrees. The student asks the professor to describe a situation that is: (a) legal but not logical, (b) logical but not legal, and (c) neither legal nor logical. When the professor fails to answer and grants the grade, the student reveals the punchline: The professor being 75 and married to a 20-year-old is legal but not logical; the young wife having a lover is not legal but logical; and the fact that the professor just gave that lover a passing grade is neither legal nor logical. A female student is seen in the background throughout the exchange.
